bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root=/mnt/g/GserverStorage/public_channel_videos
mountpoint -q /mnt/g || exit 41
test -d "$root" || exit 42
units=$(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend | awk '{print $1}' | while read -r u; do systemctl --user cat "$u" 2>/dev/null | grep -Fq 'theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV' && printf '%s\n' "$u" || :; done)
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$units" | grep -c . || :)" -eq 1 || exit 43
unit="$units"
state=$(systemctl --user is-active "$unit" || :)
pid=$(systemctl --user show "$unit" -p MainPID --value)
printf 'STATE=%s\nPID=%s\n' "$state" "$pid"
test "$state" = active || exit 61
test "$pid" -gt 1 || exit 62
test -d "/proc/$pid" || exit 63
printf 'VIDEO_FILES='
find "$root" -type f \( -iname '*.mp4' -o -iname '*.mkv' -o -iname '*.webm' -o -iname '*.mov' -o -iname '*.avi' \) | wc -l
printf 'ID783_MATCHES='
find "$root" -type f -iname '*783*' | wc -l
printf 'PARTIAL_FILES='
find "$root" -type f \( -iname '*.part' -o -iname '*.tmp' -o -iname '*.download' \) | wc -l
printf 'JOURNAL_LAST_30='
journalctl --user -u "$unit" --since '30 minutes ago' --no-pager -q | wc -l
before=$(awk '/^(rchar|wchar|read_bytes|write_bytes):/{s+=$2}END{print s+0}' "/proc/$pid/io")
sleep 5
after=$(awk '/^(rchar|wchar|read_bytes|write_bytes):/{s+=$2}END{print s+0}' "/proc/$pid/io")
printf 'IO_DELTA=%s\n' "$((after-before))"
test "$after" -gt "$before" || exit 65
